description: This source file is an extension of the ChannelsStore class adding asynchronous lifecycle management methods, specifically start, stop, refresh, and login/logout functionalities for WhatsApp and Telegram channels. It interacts with external connections and manages internal state related to channel sessions.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginStartResult
classes.description: Holds the result of starting a WhatsApp login, including QR code data URL and message.

classes.name: WhatsAppLoginWaitResult
classes.description: Contains the status message and connection status after waiting for WhatsApp login.

classes.name: ChannelLogoutResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a channel logout operation, including whether the credentials were cleared.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates a polling task that periodically refreshes channel status, unless in preview mode or already polling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the polling task if it is running.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the current status snapshot asynchronously, handling errors and updating internal state.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Starts WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waiting for connection.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for a WhatsApp login to establish, updating connection state accordingly.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out of WhatsApp and clears related credentials.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out of Telegram, handling environment token settings and reloading config.
